name: floating-sidebar-survives-accessibility
description:
The floating sidebar keeps its renderer while accessibility is on.

The floating mode adds the .ovresize handle, a plain div with a title. The hint layer once copied that title into an aria-label, and Blink DCHECKs on a name over a role-less element in WebUI. The DCHECK fires only when accessibility is active, so the scenario forces it with a flag.

actions.note: docked -> floating, which adds the .ovresize handle

actions.expression: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('.ovresize'); if (!h) { return 'no handle'; } return (h.dataset.hintTitle || 'unparked') + ' / ' + (h.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'no label'); })()

actions.note: the DCHECK fired on the next accessibility tree update
